messages:
Nina (Finance): Heads up — morning batch produced a pair of invoices for customer Skylark with different totals. One lacks the reserved_capacity discount line.
Raj (Billing): Which invoices? I only see invoice numbers 2026-04-SK-0087 and 2026-04-SK-0087-dup in the ledger export. Totals: $9,600 vs $6,450.
Ollie (Billing-ops): InvoiceBot flagged a mismatch during PDF render. It logged a missing line item for subscription id sub_8621.
InvoiceBot: job=invoice.batch run=1794000000 status=partial_fail duplicates=1 missing_lines=1 artifact=/tmp/skylark_diff_1794.csv
Tess (Engineering): I'll check the compose step. Quick glance at staging shows the discount row filtered by a new validation rule if "usage_window" is null. That seems wrong.
Nina (Finance): The reserved_capacity credit should never be conditional on usage_window. It's a billing contract term.
Raj (Billing): We pushed a validation tweak last week to drop empty-window rows to reduce noise. That likely removed the credit entry which had an empty window due to a legacy migration.
Ollie (Billing-ops): Can we regenerate only Skylark's invoice? Need to avoid rerunning full batch to not disturb other customers.
Tess (Engineering): Yes, we have a targeted recompose endpoint. Running: POST /internal/billing/recompose?account=skylark&run=1794000000
Tess (Engineering): Recompose returned success, PDF generated as 2026-04-SK-0087-R1. Credit row present.
Raj (Billing): I'll mark 2026-04-SK-0087-dup as void and attach explanation in ledger note: "voided due to missing reserved_capacity credit caused by validation rule change".
Ava (Acct Exec): Please cc me on the customer comms. I want to include the credit memo and a short apology note.
Nina (Finance): Drafting credit memo now. Amount is $3,150. Need Legal to sign off?
Ava (Acct Exec): No legal needed for this credit, just my approval. Go ahead.
InvoiceBot: ledger_update invoice=2026-04-SK-0087-dup action=voided reason=missing_line note_id=LN-7391
Raj (Billing): Voided and replaced. Sent corrected invoice + credit memo to Skylark.
Ollie (Billing-ops): Will add a post-deploy guard: validation rules cannot drop rows with tag "contract_credit". Also adding unit test for migration cases.
Tess (Engineering): Patch created and scheduled to main. Will include a monitoring alert when invoice diff > 0 for same invoice_id.
Nina (Finance): Thanks. Add a runbook step for targeted recompose and customer notification template.
Ava (Acct Exec): Received customer ack, they requested an itemized breakdown. Raj, could you include subscription-level lines?
Raj (Billing): Sent updated line-item breakdown to Ava and attached to the support ticket.
Nina (Finance): Closing this thread — corrected invoice issued, duplicate voided, guard added. Reopen if any follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
